diagnostic_convention: finite-change allocation for drytheta=(pert_theta_m+300)/(1+r*qv), evaluated inREAL64 from actual native operands. End-point denominators explicitly shared by source/transport components; not counterfactual causal experiments. Temperature adds separate Exner-pressure term. Native arithmetic is replayed exactly and diagnostic residuals reported without fitted physical tolerance

decision.action: retain_fixed_production_physics_and_limit_afternoon_forecast_applicability; assess native7–8 vertical transport and adjacent thermodynamic/vertical-motion state before coefficient changes
decision.layer6: radiation and PBL cool, microphysics warms, and large horizontal/vertical transports mostly cancel. No single process equals the net cooling
decision.layers7_8: warming is mainly transport, with a large vertical contribution. Layer8 vapor drying is also mainly vertical plus horizontal transport, not a large local PBL vapor sink
decision.layers9_11: layer9 horizontal and vertical transports both moisten; layers10–11 horizontal moistening offsets vertical drying. Do not group these distinct structures as whole-layer drying
decision.inversion_contrast: below-layer6 physical cooling and above-layer7/8 transport warming coexist. PBL is a real contributor to lower-layer cooling, but these data do not establish an erroneous mixing coefficient
decision.next_single_boundary: native7–8 vertical-transport contribution, required adjacent-layer theta/qv gradients and coordinate-consistent vertical motion; judge that state against existing driving/independent atmospheric constraints before any physical correction
decision.prior_step_closed: actual12–17UTC temperature/vapor operator attribution complete; preserve the biased12UTC start, PR203 loss trace, PR204 observations, PR205 input-chain findings and original fixed-cell scores

interpretation_limits: Finite-change moist/dry-theta attribution has declared end-state denominators; it is not a set of counterfactual reruns or a latent/full-energy budget
Horizontal and vertical entries are observed conservative operator contributions, including acoustic theta transport; they are not parcel heating or signed vertical velocity observations
Direct microphysics dry-theta change is separated from moist-finish conversion/rounding even where the physics change is zero
Native arithmetic is replayed exactly. Remaining REAL64 recombination residuals are reported, never replaced by a physical correction or fitted tolerance
The7x7,k4–13 source-hour neighborhood is sampled at12–16UTC;17UTC is an actual history endpoint. It does not supply independent vertical-motion truth
One same-case bounded restart is a read-only attribution experiment, not another cold24h, general restart campaign, independent forecast case or proof of physical accuracy
